name: Azul

categories.label: Score track after wall-tiling (incl. floor penalties)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track (đã trừ phạt sàn)
categories.hint: Tile adjacency points and floor-line penalties are tracked during play; score never drops below 0.

categories.label: Complete horizontal lines
categories.hint: 2 VP per full row of 5 on the wall.

categories.label: Colors fully placed
categories.hint: 10 VP per colour with all 5 tiles on the wall.

tiebreakers.description: If still tied, victory is shared.

notes: family: abstract-objective. In-play scoring (not itemised): each placed tile scores 1 per tile in its linked row run plus its linked column run (a run of 1 counts 1 only when no neighbours); floor line penalties -1,-1,-2,-2,-2,-3,-3. Game ends after the round in which any player completes a horizontal row. Variants (Summer Pavilion style grey wall) not modelled.
